mapper.select: select * from sdsshop.u_m_warning_record where shop_code = #{shopCode} and record_id = #{recordId}

select s.shop_code, s.goodscode as goods_code, g.goodsname as goods_name, g.spec, g.unit, s.warecode as ware_code, w.warename as ware_name, sum(s.physicalqty - coalesce(s.lockedqty, 0) - coalesce(s.reservedqty, 0)) as available_qty, coalesce(r.threshold_qty, case when g.minstockqty > 0 then g.minstockqty else null end) as threshold_qty from sdsshop.u_m_stock s join sdsshop.u_m_waregoods g on g.shop_code = s.shop_code and g.goodscode = s.goodscode and g.activeflag = 1 join sdsshop.u_m_warehouse w on w.shop_code = s.shop_code and w.warecode = s.warecode and w.activeflag = 1 left join sdsshop.u_m_warning_rule r on r.shop_code = s.shop_code and r.goods_code = s.goodscode and r.ware_code = s.warecode and r.enabled = 1 where s.shop_code = #{shopCode} and s.qualityflag = 1 and s.onhandflag = 1 group by s.shop_code, s.goodscode, g.goodsname, g.spec, g.unit, s.warecode, w.warename, r.threshold_qty, g.minstockqty having threshold_qty is not null
select shop_code from s_m_shop where status = 1 order by shop_code
mapper.insert: insert ignore into sdsshop.u_m_warning_record (shop_code, goods_code, goods_name, spec, unit, ware_code, ware_name, warning_type, available_qty, threshold_qty, status, trigger_time, last_checked_time, active_key, create_time, update_time) values (#{shopCode}, #{goodsCode}, #{goodsName}, #{spec}, #{unit}, #{wareCode}, #{wareName}, 'LOW_STOCK', #{availableQty}, #{thresholdQty}, 'ACTIVE', sysdate(), sysdate(), #{activeKey}, sysdate(), sysdate())
mapper.update: update sdsshop.u_m_warning_record set available_qty = #{availableQty}, threshold_qty = #{thresholdQty}, last_checked_time = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where active_key = #{activeKey} and status in ('ACTIVE', 'ACKNOWLEDGED')

update sdsshop.u_m_warning_record rec join ( select s.shop_code, s.goodscode, s.warecode, sum(s.physicalqty - coalesce(s.lockedqty, 0) - coalesce(s.reservedqty, 0)) as available_qty, coalesce(r.threshold_qty, case when g.minstockqty > 0 then g.minstockqty else null end) as threshold_qty from sdsshop.u_m_stock s join sdsshop.u_m_waregoods g on g.shop_code = s.shop_code and g.goodscode = s.goodscode and g.activeflag = 1 join sdsshop.u_m_warehouse w on w.shop_code = s.shop_code and w.warecode = s.warecode and w.activeflag = 1 left join sdsshop.u_m_warning_rule r on r.shop_code = s.shop_code and r.goods_code = s.goodscode and r.ware_code = s.warecode and r.enabled = 1 where s.shop_code = #{shopCode} and s.qualityflag = 1 and s.onhandflag = 1 group by s.shop_code, s.goodscode, s.warecode, r.threshold_qty, g.minstockqty having threshold_qty is null or available_qty > threshold_qty ) current_stock on current_stock.shop_code = rec.shop_code and current_stock.goodscode = rec.goods_code and current_stock.warecode = rec.ware_code set rec.status = 'RECOVERED', rec.available_qty = current_stock.available_qty, rec.threshold_qty = coalesce(current_stock.threshold_qty, rec.threshold_qty), rec.recovered_time = sysdate(), rec.last_checked_time = sysdate(), rec.active_key = null, rec.update_time = sysdate() where rec.shop_code = #{shopCode} and rec.status in ('ACTIVE', 'ACKNOWLEDGED')

update sdsshop.u_m_warning_record set status = 'ACKNOWLEDGED', acknowledged_by = coalesce(acknowledged_by, #{operator}), acknowledged_time = coalesce(acknowledged_time, sysdate()), handle_remark = #{remark}, update_time = sysdate() where shop_code = #{shopCode} and record_id = #{recordId} and status in ('ACTIVE', 'ACKNOWLEDGED')

update sdsshop.u_m_warning_record set status = 'CLOSED', closed_by = #{operator}, closed_time = sysdate(), handle_remark = #{remark}, active_key = null, update_time = sysdate() where shop_code = #{shopCode} and record_id = #{recordId} and status in ('ACTIVE', 'ACKNOWLEDGED')
